identityPolicy: The original precommit freeze and browser launch identity are retained verbatim. Separate start/final associations prove equality with committed implementation 09ed6726; raw identities are not relabeled.
method: 30 wall minutes; frozen generated HTML bytes; native requestAnimationFrame; Playwright UI actions and public command/query/checkpoint/restore ports; no injected gameplay state or private ticks
navigationLimit: 16 of 363 sampled friendly projections report No safe route and one Reverse escape. Five saved blocked contexts admit a direct route only in separate diagnostic copies omitting allied hulls; traffic resolution remains incomplete. Observed workload and checkpoints are unchanged.

selection.rawObservations: observations.json.gz retains the complete recorded result including raw identity, samples, transitions, commands, errors, requests and cleanup. Individual raw JSONL streams and seven exact checkpoints are also retained losslessly.
selection.scripts: Verbatim harness/diagnostic scripts use .txt suffixes to remain evidence rather than executable source in the documentation archive.
selection.derived: summary.json, compact-report.md.txt and visual-review.md.txt are derived explanatory reports.
selection.sourceAssociation: Source inventory, explicit committed associations and full artifact comparison receipts are retained; untracked result JSONs accidentally caught by the broad original inventory are explicitly excluded from tracked-source association.
selection.gzipPolicy: gzip true in staging-manifest means lossless gzip storage with deterministic mtime 0; source and stored byte counts/hashes are both retained.
selection.manifestScope: files.sha256.json is the original full local retention inventory, not a claim that every listed file is staged. staging-manifest.json indexes the actual selected copies.

excluded.reason: Avoid duplicating the 4.4 MB generated deliverable. Exact bytes already exist as demos/armored-platoon.html at the recorded implementation commit; restore through git show and verify this hash.
Intermediate screenshots remain in full local retention; archive includes start/final captures plus all screenshot hashes, complete raw transition observations and exact checkpoint bytes.
Duplicate or transient derived data; summary.json/compact-report.md.txt and complete raw observations retain their substantive evidence.

reproduction.preparation: Use a fresh directory directly under repository work/. Restore observe.cjs and browser-harness-used.js from their .txt copies, copy freeze.json unchanged, and install the repository Wildlands Playwright dependency. Keep the archived originals intact. The observer validates the frozen artifact SHA/size before launch. The historical metadata and source paths retained inside freeze.json are provenance, not instructions to overwrite files.
reproduction.duration: Native RAF and real 1,800 wall seconds; no private stepping or forced GC. Requires exclusive local browser slot and /usr/bin/chromium or PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH.
reproduction.stop: Write a reason as STOP.json in the fresh observation directory for a graceful partial run. An interrupted run is not a 30-minute pass.
reproduction.historicalDiagnosticScripts: The comparison/association/diagnostic scripts retain their original repository-relative work paths. Adapt paths in a separate reproduction copy; do not edit archived scripts or raw checkpoint evidence.
